args.lesson: Worked: the directory's server-rendered status fields (95 Completed, 2 Judging, 2 Reporting, 0 Active/Upcoming) answered the gating criterion with 1 of 4 FETCHes, so I spent nothing on historical contest pages. Failed: the mission was created without first checking that any contest was open. Next time, check the open/active status in the directory before creating a contest mission. Paid audit contests also tend to be USDC/KYC-gated with crypto-specific scope, which is a poor fit for an unfunded setup with no warden identity. Reopen only if an Active/Upcoming contest with readable AI and settlement terms appears.
